title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters
scope: This standard covers stationary storage type electric water heaters intended for heating water to a temperature below its boiling point, for domestic and similar purposes, and having a rated capacity not exceeding 200 liters.
testingRequirements: Testing includes insulation resistance, high voltage test, leakage current test, earth continuity test, and performance test (heating up time and standing loss).
certificationReqs: Mandatory BIS Certification (ISI Mark) is required under the Electrical Installation Order.

title: Safety of household and similar electrical appliances: Particular requirements for stationary storage type electric water heaters
scope: Deals with the safety of stationary storage type electric water heaters for household and similar purposes, their rated voltage being not more than 250 V for single-phase appliances and 415 V for other appliances.
testingRequirements: Protection against access to live parts, power input and current, heating, leakage current and electric strength at operating temperature.
certificationReqs: General safety standard, compliance is mandatory as part of product certification.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and including 250 V and Rated Current up to and including 16 A - Specification
scope: Applies to plugs and fixed or portable socket-outlets for a.c. only, with and without earthing contact, with a rated voltage greater than 50 V but not exceeding 250 V and a rated current not exceeding 16 A, intended for household and similar purposes, either indoors or outdoors.
testingRequirements: Dimensional checks, mechanical strength, resistance to heat, resistance to abnormal heat and fire, electrical strength.
certificationReqs: Plugs used on appliances must be BIS certified.

title: Electric Irons - Specification
scope: Covers electric dry irons and steam irons for household and similar purposes.
testingRequirements: Heating, electrical insulation, mechanical strength of soleplate.

title: Latex Foam Rubber Products
scope: Specifies requirements and methods of test for latex foam rubber products used for seating, bedding and similar applications.

title: Safety of Lamp Control Gear - Particular Requirements for d.c. or a.c. Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
scope: Specifies particular safety requirements for electronic controlgear for use on d.c. supplies up to 250 V and a.c. supplies up to 1000 V at 50 Hz or 60 Hz.
testingRequirements: Protection against electric shock, heating, endurance, fault conditions.
certificationReqs: Mandatory under Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) by MeitY.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Safety Requirements
scope: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements, together with the test methods and conditions, required to show compliance of LED-lamps with integrated means for stable operation.
testingRequirements: Insulation resistance, mechanical strength, heat resistance, fault condition testing.
